generation.scope: On the entire finite-edge locus of the fifteen-dimensional closure every standard regular window is a center-finite composable domain of vertex index four. Regularity is equivalent to the quartic parameter test through path degree 14, parameter quotient degree 13 and Koszul degree 16, and is relatively open. Polarized centers with their origin-corner Kummer class distinguish all realized indexed isomorphism classes. Proof: no nonzero relative trace fiber can mix vertex and nonvertex simples; relative graded Nakayama gives a finite centralizing extension of the original order over a DVR, so Noetherianity descends before specialization.

open_mathematics: Determine coverage and regularity on finite-edge components beyond this closure, and characterize which polarized centers and Kummer classes occur, their periods and degenerations.
